title: [Core] direct indexing on self.block_table_np in compute_slot_mapping (#22940)
wheel_note: first PyPI release after merge (2025-08-19 > 2025-08-15). Its torch pin resolves to 2.7.1+cu126 (no sm_120), so torch_fix swaps in torch 2.7.1+cu128 (same version, Blackwell-capable).

workload.cmd: VLLM_USE_V1=1 python3 benchmarks/benchmark_throughput.py --model facebook/opt-125m --backend vllm --input-len 800 --output-len 75 --num-prompts 2000 --dtype float16
workload.headline: throughput_output_tok_s
workload.note: Author ran --num-prompts 30000 (opt-125m, in 800 / out 75). We run 2000 prompts per repeat so 5 repeats x 4 arms fit in a session; same per-step hot path (compute_slot_mapping runs every step), throughput ratio comparable, absolute tok/s not 1:1 (different GPU, shorter run). Weights come from the HF cache mounted at /root/.cache/huggingface (.weights/hf on the host).

perf_gain.gain_evidence: benchmark_throughput opt-125m: +2.07% throughput; compute_slot_mapping 400+us -> 15-30us per call

reported.scale_short: author: 30000 prompts on H100-class GPU; ours: 2000 prompts on RTX 5070 Ti
reported.scale_note: Author reported +2.07% end-to-end throughput at 30000 prompts; we run 2000 prompts per repeat on an RTX 5070 Ti. Ratio is the comparable quantity, not absolute tok/s.

experiments_note: reported pct = author's end-to-end throughput gain; dashboard applies it to our measured baseline
test_note: PR changed only block_table.py; test_gpu_input_batch.py builds BlockTable/InputBatch and checks slot mappings. Perf-only PR: base and gold both expected PASS.
extra_pip_note: vllm 0.10.1 only lower-bounds transformers; pip resolved 5.x which breaks ProcessorMixin. 4.56.2 is the contemporary release (Aug 2025). pandas/datasets: benchmark_dataset.py imports.
swap_note: whole-tree swap fails: the Aug-15 tree registers _C::aqlm_gemm fake impls that the 0.10.1 wheel (post AQLM removal) lacks. files mode overlays only block_table.py (base vs merge) on the wheel's own tree.
